question: What is said about time-stated desired rules in scripture?
premises: Scripture states something about waves and so forth.
Time-stated desired rule is indicated by primacy.
There is a Pausha festival day.
inference: Time-stated desired rules are subordinated to primary indication.
plain_english: What scripture states again about waves and so forth: even time-stated desired rule is indicated by primacy; and there, on the Pausha festival day.
